items.description: Navigate to Magnus Carlsen’s player profile on Chess.com (e.g., https://www.chess.com/players/magnus-carlsen) without signing in. Full credit if the correct profile page is opened and visible. Full credit as well if access is blocked by an uncontrollable issue (site down, geo/CAPTCHA/login wall) and the agent clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent reaches Chess.com but not the specific Magnus Carlsen profile (e.g., wrong user, search results only). No credit if the agent uses a different site/source without first attempting Chess.com when Chess.com is accessible.

items.criterion: Record Blitz rating exactly as displayed
items.description: Locate and report Magnus Carlsen’s current Blitz rating on the Chess.com profile exactly as displayed (including any formatting such as commas, rating deviations, provisional marks, or symbols if shown). Full credit if the reported Blitz rating matches the on-screen value at the time. Partial credit if a Blitz rating is reported but not exactly as displayed (e.g., rounding, missing symbols/formatting) or if it’s taken from an incorrect section/page. Full credit if the Blitz rating is not visible due to an uncontrollable blocker (e.g., page not loading stats) and the agent clearly states that it could not be observed.

items.criterion: Record Bullet rating exactly as displayed
items.description: Locate and report Magnus Carlsen’s current Bullet rating on the Chess.com profile exactly as displayed (including any formatting such as commas, rating deviations, provisional marks, or symbols if shown). Full credit if the reported Bullet rating matches the on-screen value at the time. Partial credit if a Bullet rating is reported but not exactly as displayed (e.g., rounding, missing symbols/formatting) or if it’s taken from an incorrect section/page. Full credit if the Bullet rating is not visible due to an uncontrollable blocker (e.g., page not loading stats) and the agent clearly states that it could not be observed.

Do not sign in; do not challenge, message, or otherwise interact with another player; and stop after opening the profile and recording the Blitz and Bullet ratings. Full credit if all constraints are followed and the agent stops immediately after collecting the two ratings. Partial credit if the agent performs unnecessary extra browsing but does not violate constraints. No credit if the agent signs in or initiates any interaction (challenge/message) with another player.
